test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The excessive __using of pocket calculators__ can stultify your capacity to do mental calculations.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct phrase to be substituted in the above sentence is **"use of pocket calculators".**
 
• The given sentence is in the **present tense** and the **"use"** is a noun functioning as the subject of the sentence.
 
• The error lies in the use of the gerund form **"using"** instead of the noun form **"use."**
 
• Hence, **"use of pocket calculators"** is the correct phrase to be substituted.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

**Correct Sentence**: "The excessive **use of pocket calculators**__ can stultify your capacity to do mental calculations."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Aversion of pocket calculators"** is incorrect because it uses the noun "aversion," which refers to a feeling of strong dislike.
 
• **"Used of pocket calculators"** is incorrect because it** **uses "used," which is the past participle form of the verb "use."
 
• **"Utility of pocket calculators"** is incorrect because it uses "utility," which refers to the usefulness or practical value of something.
